name: manga-production
description: Plan manga pages from story drafts and reference images, then generate completed page images with imagegen.

interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for turning story drafts, character references, and user-provided images into planned manga pages. It expands drafts according to the selected mode, chooses a manuscript template, writes clear panel-by-panel art and dialogue briefs, and uses imagegen to generate complete manga pages one page at a time.
defaultPrompt: Use $manga-generation to make a 5-page manga from my draft and references.
Use $manga-generation in Slight Expansion mode for this story draft.
Use $manga-generation to plan panels before page generation.
